properties.name: Coso Junction Safety Roadside Rest Area
properties.notes: US-395, Olancha area, Inyo County, 17 mi south of the Rte 395/190 junction -- squarely on the Mojave-to-Bishop leg of the trip. Serves both directions (Caltrans lists N & S). Restrooms, water, picnic tables, phone, ADA access; no RV dump. 8-hour/24-hour limit, sleeping in vehicle OK, no camping (21 CCR 2205(b)). Open high desert -- expect wind and highway noise; lighting not stated by source.

properties.name: Crestview Safety Roadside Rest Area
properties.notes: US-395, Mono County, 6.4 mi north of the June Lake Junction (SR-203) -- the closest official CA rest area to Lee Vining on the 395 corridor. Serves both directions. Restrooms, water, picnic tables, phone, ADA access; no RV dump. 8-hour/24-hour limit, sleeping in vehicle OK, no camping (21 CCR 2205(b)). High desert, ~7000 ft -- can be cold at night even in summer; not confirmed by source, general route knowledge.

properties.name: Division Creek Safety Roadside Rest Area
properties.notes: US-395, Inyo County, 10 mi north of Independence -- between Bishop and Lee Vining. Serves both directions. Restrooms, water, picnic tables, phone, ADA access; no RV dump. 8-hour/24-hour limit, sleeping in vehicle OK, no camping (21 CCR 2205(b)).

properties.name: Donner Summit Safety Roadside Rest Area (eastbound)
properties.notes: I-80 eastbound on Donner Pass, Nevada County -- high-Sierra stop on the I-80 leg into Reno. Restrooms, water, picnic tables, phone, ADA access; no RV dump. 8-hour/24-hour limit, sleeping in vehicle OK, no camping (21 CCR 2205(b)). Summit elevation ~7200 ft: snow/ice possible outside summer, chain control zone -- not part of the Caltrans facility record, noted from general route knowledge.

properties.name: Donner Summit Safety Roadside Rest Area (westbound)
properties.notes: I-80 westbound counterpart on Donner Pass, Nevada County. Restrooms, water, picnic tables, phone, ADA access; no RV dump. 8-hour/24-hour limit, sleeping in vehicle OK, no camping (21 CCR 2205(b)).

properties.name: Gaviota Safety Roadside Rest Area (northbound)
properties.notes: US-101 northbound, at the south end of the Gaviota Tunnel, Santa Barbara County. Closest official CA rest area to Ventura on the 101 corridor (~33 mi north). Restrooms, water, picnic tables, phone, ADA access per Caltrans; no RV dump station. 8-hour/24-hour limit, sleeping in vehicle OK, no camping (21 CCR 2205(b)). Lot grade, lighting and typical noise level are not stated by Caltrans -- expect Highway 101 tunnel traffic noise; unverified beyond that.

properties.name: Gaviota Safety Roadside Rest Area (southbound)
properties.notes: US-101 southbound counterpart to the northbound Gaviota rest area, same tunnel location, Santa Barbara County. Restrooms, water, picnic tables, phone, ADA access per Caltrans; no RV dump. 8-hour/24-hour limit, sleeping in vehicle OK, no camping (21 CCR 2205(b)). Lighting/noise not stated by source.

properties.name: Gold Run Safety Roadside Rest Area (eastbound)
properties.notes: I-80 eastbound between the Sawmill and Gold Run overcrossings, Placer County (near Dutch Flat) -- foothill stop on I-80 before the climb to Donner Summit and Reno. Restrooms, water, picnic tables, phone, ADA access; no RV dump. 8-hour/24-hour limit, sleeping in vehicle OK, no camping (21 CCR 2205(b)).

properties.name: Gold Run Safety Roadside Rest Area (westbound)
properties.notes: I-80 westbound counterpart at Gold Run/Dutch Flat, Placer County. Restrooms, water, picnic tables, phone, ADA access; no RV dump. 8-hour/24-hour limit, sleeping in vehicle OK, no camping (21 CCR 2205(b)).

properties.name: Tejon Pass Safety Roadside Rest Area (northbound)
properties.notes: I-5 northbound at the Tejon Pass/Grapevine summit, Kern County, 3.5 mi north of Gorman -- the I-5 waypoint on the way from the Ventura/LA basin area toward SR-14/US-395. Restrooms, water, picnic tables, phone, ADA access per Caltrans; no RV dump. Summit elevation ~4200 ft -- can be cold, windy, occasionally icy in winter (not covered by the Caltrans facility record; noted from general route knowledge, not a verified source claim). 8-hour/24-hour limit, sleeping in vehicle OK, no camping (21 CCR 2205(b)).

properties.name: Tejon Pass Safety Roadside Rest Area (southbound)
properties.notes: I-5 southbound counterpart at Tejon Pass, Kern County. Restrooms, water, picnic tables, phone, ADA access per Caltrans; no RV dump. 8-hour/24-hour limit, sleeping in vehicle OK, no camping (21 CCR 2205(b)).

properties.name: Wadsworth Rest Area (I-80 westbound, mile marker ~42-43)
properties.notes: Location and mile marker from camping.org and nevadarestareas.com (secondary/user-report aggregators), not NDOT's own site -- dot.nv.gov blocked automated fetch (403) and its Wayback snapshot had no usable content. Westbound-access-only, I-80 near Wadsworth, the last formal rest stop before the climb into Reno on this corridor. Overnight-policy reports directly conflict between sources: one summary (citing NDOT generally) states an 18-hour limit within any 2-week period with sleeping in the vehicle permitted; a different rest-area review site states a flat 24-hour limit with 'no overnight parking and no overnight camping,' napping only. Could not independently confirm either against an official NDOT source -- verify posted signage on arrival, do not assume either rule holds.
